What should I do if the tracking never updates?
Maya, I understand how frustrating it is when tracking doesn’t update — let’s get this sorted.
Quick checks you can do first:
Tracking numbers only go live once the carrier scans the parcel — this can take up to 48 hours from dispatch. An inactive number isn’t always a delay.
Check your dispatch confirmation email (it contains the tracking link) and your account page — the order status will change to “Dispatched” and the tracking link will appear there.
Check your spam/junk folders and any email filters.
Remember we dispatch on UK working days (Mon–Fri), so orders placed at the weekend start processing the next working day.
If the tracking still hasn’t updated after 48 hours, may I please have your order number? It should start with the letter “C” — I’ll check the status for you.
If you’d like, I can connect you to someone from our Customer Care team for further assistance.
